Overview

The CITE-seq analysis profiled 141,852 human peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) with RNA expression and ADT measurements. Weighted Nearest Neighbor (WNN) integration identified 49 clusters, which were grouped into 18 broad cell-lineage categories.
